# Remote — Remote for Startups

Percentage discount on Remote's service fees for startups. The readable page states partner-referred startups get 20% off all hires in their first year, and that introducing a non-partner investor adds 5% up to a 20% ceiling.

### Notes

WHAT I COULD NOT INSPECT: every Remote support-centre article carrying the hard terms returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching and was never opened — the base discount percentage (support.remote.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407291107725), the eligibility rule (…/4407285494925), the discount validity period (…/4407291167757), and the annual-plan-only condition (…/4407291143693). Those four articles are where the commonly cited "15% for pre-seed/seed/Series A companies funded by a VC, accelerator or incubator, annual plans only, 12 months" terms live, and I am NOT asserting them here because I could not read them. Only two remote.com pages rendered: /partners/vc-partners, which states the 20% partner-referred figure and the +5% introduction bonus and describes partners as "incubators, accelerators, venture capital and private equity firms, angel syndicates, and other startup-enabling organizations", and /global-hr/startups, which repeats only the +5% sentence. Neither readable page states the base self-serve percentage as prose, any funding-stage requirement, or the annual-plan condition — hence all gates are unknown and amount fields are null. duration_months 12 reflects the readable statement that the discount applies to hires "made in their first year with Remote". Remote's pricing page publishes no startup discount at all. Two rates are published: 15% direct ("special startup pricing, which consists of a 15% discount on Remote's services") and 20% through a partner. Also verbatim: "If your investor is not a Remote for Startups partner, we'd love to chat with them! Introduce us, and you'll get an additional 5% off (up to a 20% discount)."
